# Instruments and sound

A layer's `instrument` is one of these ids, exactly. Each line gives the roles it can play and what it sounds like. Drum sounds play their own role or `fx` (a `909_bd` is a kick); pitched sounds play any of bass, chords, lead, pad and fx.

Roles: `kick` `snare` `hat` `clap` `rim` `bass` `chords` `lead` `pad` `fx`. Default octave of degree 1 by pitched role: bass 2, chords 3, lead 4, pad 3, fx 4.

## Mix intent

- **mix** (score): `clean`, `lofi-tape`, `club`, `cinematic`, `bedroom-pop`, `trap`
- **presence** (score, section or layer): `back`, `mid`, `front`
- **tone** (score, section or layer; skips drums): `dark`, `warm`, `neutral`, `bright`
- **space** (layer): `dry`, `room`, `hall`

## Raw fx

Fine-tuning on top of the mix intent, as `name=value` on a layer line.

| fx | range | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `gain` | 0–1.5 | level; 0.2–0.9 typical |
| `lpf` | 20–20000 | low-pass cutoff in Hz; lower = darker |
| `hpf` | 20–20000 | high-pass cutoff in Hz; clears mud below it |
| `lpq` | 0–50 | low-pass resonance |
| `room` | 0–1 | reverb send |
| `size` | 0–10 | reverb length in seconds (Strudel roomsize); 2 s when unset |
| `delay` | 0–1 | delay send |
| `pan` | 0–1 | 0 left, 0.5 centre, 1 right |
| `crush` | 1–16 | bit depth; lower = crunchier |
| `shape` | 0–1 | waveshaping drive |
| `attack` | 0–4 | seconds |
| `release` | 0–8 | seconds |
| `lpenv` | 0–8 | filter envelope depth: octaves the low-pass opens above lpf on each note; needs lpf |
| `lpattack` | 0–4 | filter envelope attack, seconds |
| `lpdecay` | 0–4 | filter envelope decay, seconds |
| `lpsustain` | 0–1 | filter envelope sustain, 0 (back to lpf) to 1 (stays open); unset, 0 with lpdecay and 1 without |
| `lprelease` | 0–8 | filter envelope release, seconds. With no stage set: 0.005 attack, 0.14 decay, 0 sustain, 0.1 release (Strudel) |
| `chorus` | 0–1 | chorus amount: modulated short delays, spread left and right |
| `tremolo` | 0–1 | tremolo depth: how far the level dips on each wobble (Strudel tremolodepth) |
| `tremrate` | 0.1–20 | tremolo speed in Hz, 5 when unset (Strudel tremolo) |
| `delaytime` | 0.03125–1 | delay time as a fraction of a bar: 0.1875 dotted eighth (the default), 0.25 quarter, 0.125 eighth |
| `delayfeedback` | 0–0.9 | delay feedback: how much each echo repeats; 0.5 unmixed, the preset's when mixed, if unset |
